Sect: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}

The Lasombra are an aristocratic and ruthless clan that commands shadow itself through Obtenebration, and many serve as the guiding hand behind the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat}'s leadership and ideology. They prize ambition, manipulation, and the control of both mortal and Kindred institutions.

Disciplines: Dominate, Obtenebration, Potence

Advantage: Lasombra excel at dominating the wills of others and manipulating the shadows around them for both defense and assault.

Disadvantage: No Lasombra can see their own reflection in a mirror or be captured on camera or in recordings, a lingering curse of their bond with darkness.

Organization: Deeply embedded in @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} leadership; a notable @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla}-aligned offshoot, the Lasombra antitribu, rejects the parent clan's Sabbat loyalties.

See also: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{the Sabbat}, which Lasombra co-founded alongside the Anarch Revolt that shattered the old order.
